prompt_mapping_enhancements.prompt_strategy: Emphasize 'natural freckles', 'visible freckles', add density/coverage/contrast as explicit modifiers
Break iris into atomic tokens: 'light green iris', 'hazel flecks scattered pattern', 'moderate limbal ring'
Add 'natural skin texture', 'visible pores', 'not airbrushed' as negative prompts against over-smoothing
For 'smoky-eye'/'heavy-smoky-eye-with-black-liner', use stronger descriptors: 'dramatic smoky eye', 'thick black eyeliner'
Combine with Lips.Color: 'nude-pink glossy lips', 'matte red lips', etc.
